riskDescription.context: The UAT milestone was scheduled for completion on June 30, 2026, but as of July 22, 2026, it shows 0% completion, 22 days past the due date. The revised UAT Signoff dates are now August 14 and August 25, 2026, representing a 45-56 day delay. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If UAT Sign-off is not achieved by August 25, 2026, or if additional defects are discovered during UAT requiring extended remediation cycles
riskDescription.consequence: The Go-Live milestone, already delayed 7 days past its July 15, 2026 scheduled date, may slip beyond the revised Prod Deploy date following August 25, 2026, further deferring Milestone 6 revenue ($130,000) and potentially impacting the mass producer onboarding planned for October 22, 2026.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish daily defect triage and UAT coordination meetings with Premera stakeholders through August 25 to accelerate sign-off.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon UAT Sign-off delay beyond August 25, escalate to Premera program leadership and Ascendion engagement manager within 24 hours to revise Go-Live date and assess mass onboarding impact.

riskDescription.context: The Go-Live milestone was scheduled for July 15, 2026, but as of July 22, 2026, it shows 0% completion, 7 days past the due date. The revised Prod Deploy date is set to follow the August 25, 2026 UAT Signoff, representing a 41+ day delay. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If UAT Sign-off is delayed beyond August 25, 2026, or if post-UAT defects require extended remediation before production deployment
riskDescription.consequence: The Go-Live milestone will slip further beyond the revised Prod Deploy date, deferring Milestone 6 revenue ($130,000) and Milestone 7 Hypercare revenue ($130,000), and may jeopardize the mass producer onboarding rollout planned for October 22, 2026, which depends on production deployment completion.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct pre-deployment validation with Premera IT and business teams by August 20 to confirm production readiness before UAT Sign-off.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should production deployment encounter critical defects post-UAT Sign-off, activate rollback to pre-deployment state and engage Premera program leadership within 2 hours to revise mass onboarding schedule.

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75-1 sprint of additional effort (12.5-25% of the 4-sprint plan) under a fixed-price contract of $650,000, with no change request values stated for the 19 scope changes listed in the Scope Change Tracker. The active scope change risk, opened June 29, 2026, has no mitigation plan beyond 'needs to be arrived' and no due date. (EMS - Risks; ART - SOW; ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If further scope additions occur without corresponding contract amendments or if the absorbed scope effort is not recovered through efficiency gains
riskDescription.consequence: The project margin will erode as uncompensated effort accumulates, potentially resulting in cost overrun and reduced profitability, with the fixed-price contract preventing revenue recovery for the absorbed 0.75-1 sprint of effort.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal change control requiring Premera program leadership sign-off and impact assessment before any new scope enters sprint backlog.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When scope change requests exceed 1 additional sprint of effort, initiate contract amendment discussion with Premera within 5 business days to recover margin impact.

riskDescription.context: Milestones 5 (UAT, $130,000), 6 (Go-Live, $130,000), and 7 (Hypercare, $130,000) are pending completion, representing $390,000 in deferred revenue. UAT is delayed 45-56 days (revised to August 14/25, 2026 from June 30, 2026), and Go-Live is delayed 41+ days (revised to post-August 25, 2026 from July 15, 2026). (ART - SOW; ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If milestone delays extend beyond the revised dates of August 14/25, 2026 (UAT) and post-August 25, 2026 (Go-Live)
riskDescription.consequence: Revenue recognition for Milestones 5, 6, and 7 ($390,000 total) will be deferred further, impacting cash flow and potentially delaying billing cycles by 2-3 months beyond the original schedule.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Align milestone completion criteria and invoice submission process with Premera finance team by August 10 to accelerate billing upon sign-off.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If milestone delays defer revenue beyond August 31, communicate revised billing forecast to Ascendion finance and Premera within 3 business days to adjust cash flow planning.

riskDescription.context: As of PI4 Sprint 3 (ended June 18, 2026), the project has 190 code smells (2 Critical, 80 Major, 104 Minor, 4 Info) and 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High, all on alpine base image), both with status 'In-Progress' and no closure ETA. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If code smells and CVEs are not remediated before UAT or production deployment
riskDescription.consequence: Technical debt will accumulate, requiring rework effort that diverts capacity from UAT defect remediation and post-deployment support, potentially extending UAT and Hypercare timelines and increasing the risk of production defects or security vulnerabilities.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Prioritize remediation of Critical and Major code smells and Critical CVEs in PI5 Sprint 3 backlog with completion target by August 15.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Critical code smells or CVEs remain unresolved by UAT Sign-off, document technical debt register and allocate dedicated remediation sprint post-Go-Live to prevent production impact.

riskDescription.context: As of PI4 Sprint 3 (ended June 18, 2026), the test failure rate is 15% (11 failed out of 71 functional test cases), with 1 bug open and spilled. The project also has 11 total bugs (0 Critical, 7 High, 3 Medium, 1 Low), with 7 High bugs representing 64% of the total bug count. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If the test failure rate and high-severity bug count are not reduced before UAT commencement
riskDescription.consequence: Defects may leak into UAT, requiring extended remediation cycles that further delay UAT Sign-off beyond the revised August 14/25, 2026 dates, cascading to Go-Live and Hypercare delays and increasing the risk of production defects post-deployment.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct daily defect review and prioritize closure of all High bugs by August 10 before UAT commencement to reduce failure rate.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When test failure rate exceeds 10% at UAT entry, pause UAT and allocate additional testing resource to stabilize functional test suite within 3 business days.

riskDescription.context: As of PI4 Sprint 3 (ended June 18, 2026), backend code coverage is 57%, which is 23 percentage points below the typical industry target of 80%. No improvement plan is stated in the sources. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If backend code coverage remains below 80% through UAT and production deployment
riskDescription.consequence: Untested code paths may contain defects that are not discovered until UAT or production, increasing the risk of defect leakage, extended UAT remediation cycles, and post-deployment production defects that require Hypercare support.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Increase backend unit test coverage to 70% by August 15 through targeted test case development for critical business logic paths.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If backend coverage remains below 70% at UAT entry, conduct manual code walkthrough for untested paths and document risk acceptance with Premera for known coverage gaps.

riskDescription.context: The project has no Business Analyst assigned (marked 'NA') and no QA Manager (null), creating gaps in requirements clarity, user story refinement, UAT coordination, quality governance, test strategy, and defect triage. These gaps have persisted since project start on March 1, 2026. (EMS - Resources; EMS - Project Details)
riskDescription.condition: If BA and QA Manager roles remain unfilled through UAT and production deployment
riskDescription.consequence: Requirements ambiguity and UAT coordination gaps may cause UAT delays beyond the revised August 14/25, 2026 dates, and quality governance gaps may result in defect leakage to production, increasing Hypercare support effort and potentially impacting the mass producer onboarding rollout.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Assign interim BA and QA Manager responsibilities to existing team leads by August 5 with documented UAT coordination and quality governance protocols.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If UAT coordination gaps cause sign-off delays, escalate to Premera program leadership and request dedicated client-side BA support for remaining UAT cycles.

riskDescription.context: DevOps support for the project is provided on an on-need basis by David from the AI Platform Build Claims POD, as no dedicated DevOps resource is planned. This creates a single-person dependency for IaC and DevOps issues. (ART - WSR, Decision Log #2)
riskDescription.condition: If David is unavailable when critical IaC or DevOps issues arise during ACPT deployment, UAT environment setup, or production deployment
riskDescription.consequence: Infrastructure and deployment issues may be delayed in resolution, blocking ACPT deployment readiness, UAT environment setup, or production deployment, and further delaying UAT Sign-off and Go-Live milestones beyond the revised August 14/25, 2026 and post-August 25, 2026 dates.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Document IaC runbooks and establish backup DevOps contact from Ascendion Azure practice by August 10 to mitigate single-person dependency.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If David is unavailable during critical deployment, engage Ascendion Azure practice escalation path within 4 hours to provide alternate DevOps support.

riskDescription.context: The Total Premium Fields dependency on Data Hub has an ETA of July 30, 2026, which is 8 days away as of July 22, 2026. The open risk states that if the 4 additional fields are made available on July 30, changes can only be made by August 5, 2026. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If Data Hub delays delivery of the 4 Total Premium fields beyond July 30, 2026, or if the fields require additional development time beyond August 5, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: BoB functionality will be incomplete for UAT, potentially delaying UAT Sign-off beyond the revised August 14/25, 2026 dates and cascading to Go-Live delays, as the Total Premium calculation is a core BoB feature.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate daily with Data Hub team through July 30 to confirm Total Premium field delivery and complete integration by August 5.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Data Hub delays Total Premium fields beyond July 30, implement workaround using existing billing fields and defer full Total Premium calculation to post-UAT release.

riskDescription.context: The DH Integration Data Mapping dependency, opened June 25, 2026, had an ETA of July 15, 2026, which passed 7 days prior as of July 22, 2026. The open risk states that if issues with data mapping values lead back to design (entity stitching), it may have time impact. Mitigation status is not stated. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If data mapping issues are discovered during UAT that require design changes to entity stitching logic
riskDescription.consequence: UAT Sign-off will be delayed beyond the revised August 14/25, 2026 dates due to rework effort for design changes, cascading to Go-Live delays and potentially impacting the mass producer onboarding rollout.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Validate Data Hub entity stitching logic with Premera business team by August 5 before UAT entry to prevent design rework during UAT.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If entity stitching issues are discovered during UAT, isolate affected BoB scenarios and defer to post-UAT release while proceeding with UAT Sign-off for unaffected functionality.

riskDescription.context: The Auth0 Change Propagation dependency, opened July 6, 2026, had an ETA of July 10, 2026, which passed 12 days prior as of July 22, 2026. The open risk states that the DB connection configuration needs to be updated by the Premera team as Ascendion doesn't have access to the ACPT tenant, and if delayed, it will impact the move to ACPT. Mitigation status is not stated. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If the Premera team delays updating the DB connection configuration in the ACPT tenant beyond July 10, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: ACPT deployment will be blocked, preventing UAT environment setup and delaying UAT commencement beyond the revised August 14/25, 2026 dates, cascading to Go-Live delays.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate Auth0 DB connection configuration to Premera infrastructure team by July 25 to complete ACPT tenant update before UAT entry.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Premera team cannot update ACPT tenant configuration by August 1, request temporary elevated access for Ascendion team to complete configuration under Premera supervision.

riskDescription.context: The SOW end date shows a 3-month discrepancy between sources: ART SOW states August 31, 2026, while EMS states November 30, 2026. The revised Rollout date is September 2, 2026, which extends 2 days beyond the ART SOW end date but is 89 days before the EMS SOW end date. (ART - SOW; EMS - Project Details; ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If the correct SOW end date is August 31, 2026 (per ART SOW) and the Rollout date of September 2, 2026 is confirmed
riskDescription.consequence: The project will overrun the SOW end date by 2 days, potentially requiring a contract amendment or scope reduction, and creating ambiguity around Hypercare completion and final milestone payment (Milestone 7, $130,000).

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Clarify SOW end date with Premera contract owner and Ascendion legal by August 1 to resolve discrepancy and confirm Hypercare completion terms.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If SOW end date is confirmed as August 31 and Rollout extends to September 2, initiate contract amendment request with Premera by August 15 to extend SOW through Hypercare completion.

riskDescription.context: Seven agent-related risks (Single LLM, Tools Integration, Agent Hardening, Agent Learning, Client Template Alignment, Tool/API Invocation Failures, Agent Orchestration) were opened between March 9-17, 2026, and remain open with no ETA stated as of July 22, 2026, representing 127-135 days without mitigation closure. (ART - WSR)
riskDescription.condition: If agent-related risks materialize during UAT or production deployment due to inadequate agent hardening, limited training datasets, or tool/API invocation failures
riskDescription.consequence: Agent-driven functionality may exhibit inconsistent behavior or execution failures in production, requiring manual intervention or rework, increasing Hypercare support effort and potentially impacting the mass producer onboarding rollout if agent-driven features (e.g., registration, BoB data retrieval) fail.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct agent hardening review and implement fallback logic for critical agent-driven features by August 10 before UAT entry to prevent production failures.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If agent-driven features fail during UAT or production, activate manual workaround procedures and allocate dedicated support resource to monitor agent behavior during Hypercare.

riskDescription.context: Premera is planning to send registration emails to 2,500+ producers on October 22, 2026, using a big-bang rollout approach. As of October 23, 2026, the end-to-end Edge–DataHub–Producer Portal (OKTA) registration process was completed with 11 users, and the application is technically ready for producer onboarding. Status of the mass onboarding is awaited. (ALT - Watchlist)
riskDescription.condition: If an issue is encountered during the mass producer onboarding of 2,500+ producers on October 22, 2026
riskDescription.consequence: The rollout may need to be rolled back and remediated, delaying producer onboarding, impacting Premera's business operations, and potentially extending Hypercare beyond the planned end date, which may breach the SOW end date (August 31, 2026 per ART SOW or November 30, 2026 per EMS).

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct load and defect check on production application with 100-user pilot group by October 15 before mass onboarding to validate scale readiness.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon critical defect affecting producers after mass onboarding starts, roll back to pre-deployment state within 2 hours and escalate to Premera program leadership to revise onboarding schedule.
